sloka: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता सा सुग्रीवेण च वाहिनी ।बभूव दुर्धर्षतरा सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः ।। ६.४१.५७ ।।।।
transliteration: rāmalakṣmaṇaguptā sā sugrīveṇa ca vāhinī ।babhūva durdharṣatarā sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ ।। 6.41.57 ।।।।

translations.english: Protected by Rama and Lakshmana and Sugriva that an army of monkeys became difficult to assail even for Rakshasas and Devatas.
